name: Tri-Institutional PhD Program in Computational Biology and Medicine
summary: Computational and systems biology PhD across Cornell Ithaca, Weill Cornell, Rockefeller and Memorial Sloan Kettering.

deadlines.label: All application components
deadlines.note: Source states end-of-day (midnight EST) December1,2026. No late or incomplete applications.

english.note: TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo or Cambridge English accepted direct from testing site. TOEFL/IELTS/DET valid two years. CBM FAQ English exemptions narrower than central WCGS policy; confirm program-specific eligibility.

documents: Application essay describing research experience and scientific potential
Academic transcripts; official NACES course-by-course evaluation for non-U.S. degrees including Canada
Recommendation letters from faculty/investigators familiar with research
requirements.note: Apply page expects quantitative bachelor’s/master’s degree, science GPA3.6, linear algebra, statistics, programming, foundational biology and substantive lab research. FAQ calls research beneficial rather than required; safer apply-page expectation retained. Publications not required. Interfolio not accepted. Letter count not confirmed on program sources. Fee waiver available: Documented financial hardship, requested within application before paying; allow seven business days. International eligibility not explicitly restricted, confirm. Amount not confirmed in program-specific sources.

funding.note: International students fully funded regardless of citizenship. Full tuition, fees and health insurance scholarship. Stipend published for2025–2026; confirm updated amount. No teaching requirement.
